en.title: 26 U.S.C. §877(a)(2) substitutes “2003” for “1992” in §1(f)(3)(B), which no longer contains “1992”
en.summary: Section 877(a)(2) adjusts the $124,000 tax-liability threshold for expatriates by the cost-of-living adjustment under section 1(f)(3) “by substituting ‘2003’ for ‘1992’ in subparagraph (B) thereof”. Section 1(f)(3)(B) no longer contains “1992”, so the substitution finds nothing to replace. The threshold is still used: §877A defines a covered expatriate through §877(a)(2).
en.correction: For the legislature to state the base year and the provision to which it applies.

summary.en: In release point 119-134 of the United States Code, the reference carries a footnote and a References in Text note: section 1(f)(3)(B), as amended in 2017, no longer refers to the year 1992. The wording of the section is unchanged.

responses.before: multiplied by the cost-of-living adjustment determined under section 1(f)(3) for such calendar year by substituting “2003” for “1992” in subparagraph (B) thereof.
responses.after: multiplied by the cost-of-living adjustment determined under section 1(f)(3) for such calendar year by substituting “2003” for “1992” in subparagraph (B) thereof.¹ Footnote ¹: “See References in Text note below.” References in Text note: “Section 1(f)(3)(B), referred to in subsec. (a)(2), was struck out, and a new section 1(f)(3)(B) enacted, by Pub. L. 115-97, title I, §11002(a), Dec. 22, 2017, 131 Stat. 2059. As amended, section 1(f)(3)(B) of this title no longer refers to the year 1992.”
